296.desc: 包裹头部的神秘尾巴使对手无法对我方使出先制招式。
296.effectEn: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.

297.desc: 受到地面属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会得到回复。
297.effectEn: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

298.desc: 使出变化招式时，虽然行动必定会变慢，但能不受对手的特性妨碍。
298.effectEn: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.

299.desc: 一般属性和格斗属性的招式可以击中幽灵属性的宝可梦。无视对手的闪避率的变化，且命中率不会被降低。
299.effectEn: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

300.desc: 首次出场时，会散发出甜腻的蜜的香味来降低对手的闪避率。
300.effectEn: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

301.desc: 出场时款待同伴，回复其少量HP。
301.effectEn: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

302.desc: 凭借含有毒素的锁链的力量，有时能让被招式击中的对手陷入剧毒状态。
302.effectEn: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

303.effectEn: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

304.desc: 出场时，会吸收周围的能量，变为太晶形态。
304.effectEn: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

305.desc: 甲壳蕴藏着全部属性的力量，会将自己HP全满时受到的伤害全都变为效果不好。
305.effectEn: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

306.desc: 太乐巴戈斯变为星晶形态时，蕴藏在它身上的力量会将天气和场地的影响全部归零。
306.effectEn: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

307.desc: 因桃歹郎的招式而陷入中毒状态的对手同时也会陷入混乱状态。
307.effectEn: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

308.desc: 使用接触类招式时，会无视对手的防守效果，给予原本的1/4的伤害。对手的防守以外的效果会发动。
308.effectEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

309.desc: 一般属性的招式会变为龙属性，威力会变为1.2倍。
309.effectEn: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

310.desc: 即使天气不是大晴天状态，也能以大晴天状态使用招式。
310.effectEn: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

311.desc: 受到招式的伤害时，会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
311.effectEn: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

312.effectEn: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

313.effectEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

314.effectEn: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.
